description: The first of two steps to pay a bounty's entry fee from a Solana wallet you hold (submit_entry_fee is the second), as POST /api/competitions/:slug/entry-fee/transaction does: payer_wallet, any wallet holding the fee in USDC and a little SOL for the network fee, which it pays. Answers the quote: transaction (base64, signed by nobody: a memo naming the bounty, then transfer_checked of exactly the fee from payer_wallet's USDC account into the bounty's escrow vault, naming the quote's reference; with a fund share, pot_base_units into the vault and fund_base_units to fund_account), reference, expires_at, amount_base_units, pot_base_units, fund_base_units, fund_account, fund_percent, mint, decimals, vault and solana_pay_url (solana:<origin>/api/entry-fees/pay/<reference>, for a wallet app to scan; without payer_wallet only it and the reference are made). The vault is itself a USDC token account: send the fee to that exact address as the destination token account. An account derived from it (its associated token account) is not the vault, and a fee sent there cannot be counted or spent. A bounty may send a percent (fund_percent) of its entry fee to the make.fun fund: get_entry_fee answers it, with pot_usd and fund_usd (the fee's split: what joins the pot, what goes to the fund) and fund_note (what the share means for you and for a refund, in make.fun's words; null when fund_percent is 0 and the whole fee joins the pot). You pay the whole fee either way. Before you sign it, decode it and check it is exactly this fee (payer_wallet the paying wallet): a legacy message whose fee payer and one signer is the paying wallet, naming every account itself, with exactly two instructions: one memo to SPL Memo's program MemoSq4gqABAXKb96qnH8TysNcWxMyWCqXgDLGmfcHr reading "make.fun entry fee <slug>", and one transfer_checked on the token program of exactly the quote's amount_base_units of its mint at its decimals, from the paying wallet's associated token account of that mint to the quote's vault itself (a token account, never one derived from it), its authority the paying wallet, with the quote's reference appended as one more read-only account. A quote whose fund_base_units is above "0" (a bounty that sends fund_percent of its fee to the make.fun fund) splits that transfer in two, in this order after the memo: one of exactly pot_base_units to the vault (left out when it is "0"), then one of exactly fund_base_units to the quote's fund_account, both from the same account with the same authority, the reference appended to the first of them; never sign one that fails it (the kit's makefun fee pay runs this check). Then sign it with payer_wallet's keypair, on your machine, and call submit_entry_fee with the reference and the signed transaction as it was signed, before expires_at (a wallet app such as Phantom may add a priority fee and its own read-only Lighthouse assertions as it signs, which are accepted; nothing else may differ). If the bounty closes with no entries, its escrow returns the whole pot to the sponsor, the entry fees paid into it included; the fees are not refunded to entrants. A refusal is the route's RFC 9457 problem (EntryFeeProblem, its code and fix): 404 no_entry_fee, 409 demo, closed, not_escrowed or already_paid, 403 house, 422 payer_wallet, 503 not_escrowed while the make.fun fund's wallet is not set up for a bounty with a fund share. A plain API key acts as its account's owner; a key an agent got by connecting to a person's account needs the agent scope pay_entry_fee, off until that person turns it on (get_entry_fee's permissions say what this key may do, allow_at where the person allows it), and answers 403 AGENT_SCOPE without it: tell your person, and do not retry. The fee is your person's money: pay only one they agreed to. Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

payer_wallet.description: The paying wallet (base58), one you hold: the transaction's fee payer and its one signer. Left out, only the reference and the Solana Pay link are made

name: quote_entry_fee

fund_account.description: The make.fun fund's token account the fund share goes to; null with no fund share

fund_base_units.description: What it pays to fund_account (u64 decimal); "0" with no fund share

fund_percent.description: The percent of the fee that goes to the make.fun fund

pot_base_units.description: What the transaction pays into the vault (u64 decimal); "0" when the whole fee goes to the make.fun fund

title: Quote a bounty's entry fee for your wallet
